title: Sustainability Lead: Offset due-diligence shortlist
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Show offset candidates for the projected Boston Hub overage, but do not buy or claim credits.

answer.question: Show offset candidates for the projected Boston Hub overage, but do not buy or claim credits.
answer.answer:
Here are offset candidates for the Boston Hub's projected 340 MT overage — **not purchased or claimed**:

| Project | Type | Price/t | Cost to Cover Gap | Verifier |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Appalachian Reforestation | forestry | $18.50 | $6,290 | Verra VCS |
| Texas Wind REC Bundle | renewable energy | $12.75 | $4,335 | Green-e |
| Montana Methane Capture | methane capture | $24.00 | $8,160 | ACR |
| Iowa Ag Soil Carbon | soil carbon | $22.00 | $7,480 | Gold Standard |

Cheapest option on paper is the wind REC bundle, but note a reduction plan at the facility (e.g., LDAR fixes) could close the gap at the source instead of buying credits.

This is a due-diligence shortlist only — no credits have been bought, retired, or claimed, and this isn't a compliance or legal determination. A qualified reviewer needs to sign off before any real transaction or disclosure.
